title: Successful and Cost-Effective DNA Extraction Method from Insects
author: Rahul Jamdade
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfajjicn

steps.title: Prepare Sample
steps.instruction: Dry the insect sample (previously preserved in molecular grade absolute alcohol) and transfer it into a new microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Initial Lysis and Proteinase-K Addition
steps.instruction: Add lysis reagents and Proteinase-K to the sample.

substeps.instruction: Add 600ul of pre-warmed CTAB (65°C), 3ul of Beta-Mercaptoethanol, and 10ul of 20% SDS
Crush the sample
Add 3ul of Proteinase-K

steps.title: Lysis and Incubation
steps.instruction: Vortex and incubate the samples to facilitate DNA release.

substeps.instruction: Vortex each tube vigorously for 3-5 minutes
Incubate at 65°C for 4-5 hours (preferably using a shaking heating block, or vortex every 30 minutes)

steps.title: First Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Cool samples to room temperature and centrifuge at 14,000 rpm for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Phenol-Chloroform-Isoamyl Alcohol Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform an organic extraction to remove proteins.

substeps.instruction: Add an equal volume of Phenol: chloroform: Isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1)
Vortex for 3-5 minutes
Centrifuge at 14,000 rpm for 10 minutes
Transfer the supernatant to a fresh microfuge tube and discard the pellet

steps.title: Chloroform-Isoamyl Alcohol Purification
steps.instruction: Further purify the DNA using chloroform and isoamyl alcohol.

substeps.instruction: Add 600ul of Chloroform: Isoamyl alcohol (24:1) to each tube and mix by vortexing
Centrifuge at 12,000 rpm for 10 minutes
Transfer the supernatant to a fresh microcentrifuge tube

steps.title: DNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate the DNA using chilled isopropanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 400ul of chilled isopropanol and mix slowly until white flakes appear
Store at -20°C in a deep freeze for 1 hour
Bring the sample to room temperature
Centrifuge at 10,000 rpm for 10 minutes

steps.title: DNA Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the DNA pellet to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Decant the supernatant
Add 400ul of 70% chilled ethanol and 100ul of ammonium acetate to the pellet
Centrifuge at 10,000 rpm for 10 minutes
Decant the supernatant carefully
Add 400ul of absolute alcohol and centrifuge at 10,000 rpm for 10 minutes
Decant the supernatant
Dry the pellet at room temperature or in a speed vac (Program ‘-OH’, 15 minutes at 30°C)
Add 10-30ul of nuclease free water
Incubate samples in a dry bath at 55°C for 30 minutes
Store at -20°C or -80°C for long term storage

steps.title: Prepare CTAB Extraction Buffer (50ml)
steps.instruction: Prepare the CTAB buffer and autoclave before use.

substeps.instruction: Combine 5ml 1M Tris-HCl, 2ml 0.5M EDTA, 17.5ml 5M NaCl, and 10ml 10% CTAB (5g in 50ml)
Add 15.5ml Distilled Water to reach final volume
Adjust pH to 7.5-8.0
Autoclave the entire content
